traceability.notes: The story is a concrete specification (not a story map), and all of its acceptance criteria and listed requirements are satisfied: - Core Functionality & Plugin Structure (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE) are verified by passing tests in tests/plugin-setup.test.ts, tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts, and by the npm package structure in package.json. - ESLint v9 Flat Config compatibility (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT, Integration AC) is confirmed by passing tests in tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts which load and run the plugin using flat config presets. - Error Handling (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, Error Handling AC) is covered by tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts, both tagged to Story 001.0 and passing in the latest run. - TypeScript implementation and test infrastructure (REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP) are evidenced by TypeScript tooling in package.json and the comprehensive Jest-based test suite (40 passing suites, 304 tests). - Documentation, Quality Standards, and User Experience ACs are supported by existing development guides and user docs (development guides in docs/, README.md, and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md) which are also referenced by and aligned with the integration tests. Given the successful, up-to-date test run and the presence of all referenced implementation and documentation files, this story is fully implemented.
